newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan says gambling purge may hurt feelings.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan says gambling purge may hurt feelings.

text.p: Taiwan has ordered a crackdown on gambling during the Lunar New Year holiday which it admits might "hurt some people's feelings", state media reported on Friday.

Justice Minister Liao Cheng-hao said local prosecutors and police would come down hard on any gambling during the five-day holiday, the state-funded Central News Agency said. "Gambling is the source of all crimes," the agency quoted Liao as saying. "It may hurt people's feeling to completely eliminate our countrymen's gambling tradition during the new year...but we cannot have any exception."
Gambling is illegal in Taiwan, but betting on mahjong and cards is common at home, and groups gather to gamble in open markets and outside temples.
